name: Kron's Amulet
summary: Along the Southfury River, Kron’s amulet recalls a young orc hunter who went missing.

sections.title: Tragedy on the Southfury
sections.body: Kron was a headstrong young orc from a farmstead northwest of Razor Hill. He went to hunt the vicious Dreadmaw crocolisks along the Southfury River, on the border with the Barrens. His mother, Misha Tor'kren, warned him of the danger, but pride carried him onward. Kron never returned. His amulet was found inside one of the river’s predators, confirming he had been slain and devoured. It gives Misha painful confirmation of her son’s fate.

faq.answer: Kron was a headstrong young orc hunter who lived with his mother, Misha Tor'kren, on a farmstead northwest of Razor Hill. He went alone to test his strength against the river beasts, despite warnings of their ferocity.

aliases: where do i find the amulet
faq.answer: Dreadmaw Crocolisks and Corrupted Dreadmaw Crocolisks along the banks of the Southfury River in Durotar carry Kron's Amulet in their bellies.

aliases: where to turn in kron's amulet
faq.answer: Misha Tor'kren wants Kron's Amulet returned. She awaits word of her son at her farmstead northwest of Razor Hill, and the amulet gives her painful confirmation of his fate.

angles.text: As an orc, Kron's fate shows how pride and the pursuit of martial glory can lead one to ignore the wisdom of elders, with deadly consequences.
As a hunter, Kron's fate is a stark lesson in the danger of underestimating vicious beasts in unfamiliar river territory.
